events.command: node --test tests/cart.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E '^(ok|not ok|# (pass|fail))'; git stash -q; node --test tests/cart.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E '^(ok|not ok|# (pass|fail))'; git stash pop -q; git diff

d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/src $d/tests; git show HEAD:src/cart.js > $d/src/cart.js; cp tests/cart.test.js $d/tests/; cp package.json $d/; node --test $d/tests/cart.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E '^(ok|not ok|# (pass|fail))|actual|expected'; git status --short
